name: tdb
description: Connect Claude to a TDB server: governed, audited, read-only SQL over your data.
long_description:
Connects Claude Desktop to your self-hosted TDB server. TDB turns your databases and CSVs into governed, read-only SQL that Claude reaches over MCP, and records every call in an audit log you own, naming Claude as the client.

Your API key is kept in your system's secure credential store and sent only to the TDB server you configure. The extension collects no telemetry.

server_url.title: TDB server URL
server_url.description: Base URL of your TDB server, for example http://localhost:8000

api_key.title: TDB API key
api_key.description: Stored in your system's secure credential store
